data.name: Mirenhold
data.detailed_description:
Mirenhold isn't just an MMORPG. It's a living, breathing world where your actions have consequences. NPCs change their dialogue based on your reputation. Rare boss drops unlock new quest lines. Your bestiary accumulates knowledge about monsters as you kill them.

Combat System

Skills with casting times, DoT and HoT effects, critical hits, and spell interrupts. Combat requires attention—any enemy can kill the unwary.

Weapons

Your weapon lives with you. Every enemy you kill adds a point to the item's history. You can't simply sell an item—it's your story!

Quests and Dialogues Through Reputation

Factions monitor your actions. The higher your reputation, the deeper your dialogue, the better the prices you'll get from merchants, and the more dangerous the enemies you'll encounter.

Exploration with Rewards

Discovering new zones is an event. Bonus, journal entry, and new dialogue options with NPCs who know you were there.

Cooperative hunting without coercion

No mandatory groups! But if another player attacks the same monster nearby, both players receive an experience bonus. An organic community, not artificial tools.

Champions and Zone Events

Have you been hunting in one place for too long? The world reacts—a Champion of increased difficulty appears. Destroy them to receive a rare drop and the attention of the faction.

Bestiary

Uncover monsters. The more you kill creatures of the same type, the more information you gain: weaknesses, rare drops, behavior. Knowledge is power.

Not for everyone

Mirenhold is a demanding game. The world is unforgiving, enemies are aggressive, and death has a price. If you're looking for a challenge, atmosphere, and an RPG with real depth, you've found it.

The game is in active development!

data.short_description: Mirenhold is a medieval fantasy MMORPG where the world is ancient, the dangers are real, and death carries weight. Explore a mystery-laden world with deep lore, forge alliances with other players, and face challenges that demand skill, patience, and sacrifice!
